text: Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund (PIF) owns 50% of noon, which it accounts for as a joint venture; the other half is held by investors led by founder Mohamed Alabbar.

source.name: Public Investment Fund: Consolidated Financial Statements for the year ended 31 December 2024 (archived copy of pif.gov.sa PDF), note 12.4 (investment in joint ventures)
source.quote: Noon Investments Company (“Noon”) Consumer Discretionary 50% 50% Kingdom of Saudi Arabia

additionalSources.name: The National: Alabbar’s Noon.com launches operations in Saudi Arabia
additionalSources.quote: US$1bn e-commerce platform is 50 per cent owned by Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund (PIF)

additionalSources.name: Bloomberg (Zainab Fattah): Amazon Rival Noon to Draw $2 Billion From PIF, Other Backers (via Yahoo Finance)
additionalSources.quote: Alabbar, who owns 50% of Noon jointly with other regional private investors, raised $1 billion from backers including the PIF to create the firm in 2016.
